I’ve gotten to the point where I can get my AI to one shot a whole scene near perfect. But how do I get to the next level? Time to try blender block outs. And the cool thing is, as a 3D artist, if the AI messes up, I can just fix it. The block out should 10x the final video renders. Or just make them complicated cause I be doing too much. Excited to start testing again.
Oh and stop chasing trends, create some new stuff 🤦🏽‍♂️
